name: Riho Terras - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on the 2023 and 2024 Commission Reports on Kosovo
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out its opinion on Kosovo's progress towards joining the European Union. It praises Kosovo's commitment and asks EU member states to move Kosovo's membership application forward, including the five countries that do not recognise Kosovo. It calls for the EU to lift its measures against Kosovo. It also asks Kosovo to do more on courts, corruption, media freedom, minority rights and relations with Serbia. The report is an opinion; it does not change any law.

- The report is an opinion only; no law changes and no country is bound by it.
- It concerns Kosovo's government, its Serb minority, Serbia, and EU member states.
- Next, EU member states decide whether to act on the calls, such as lifting measures.
